taste: Quick daily browser games: name-the-top-10 lists, rare-answer trivia, sports roster/draft builders, geography connections, and list-style Sporcle quizzes.

games.name: Daily Tens
games.blurb: Name all ten entries on today's top-10 list before 5 misses.

games.name: Krillion
games.blurb: 7 prompts a day. Rare answers sink you deeper.

games.name: Moonshot
games.blurb: Name the common answers, then the blue-moon ones, then climb The Ladder.
Spin a team and decade, draft NBA legends, try to go undefeated.
The football version, plus 162-0, 100-0, 8-0 and more on the same site.

games.name: World Connections
games.blurb: Connections, but geography.

games.name: PSNN Fantasy Drafts
games.blurb: Fantasy draft games.

games.name: Magnitudle
games.blurb: Estimation games: Size It Up, Weigh It Up, Weekly 1K, Survival and more.

games.name: Cutle
games.blurb: Cut the shape in half with one line. How close to 50/50 can you get?

games.name: Top 10s: Big 4 Sports
games.blurb: Sporcle top-10 lists across the NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL.

games.name: NBA All-Time Scorers
games.blurb: Name the NBA's all-time leading scorers.

games.name: NBA Top 5s
games.blurb: Top-5 lists from NBA history.

games.name: Sporcle: Popular Sports Today
games.blurb: Today's most-played sports quizzes, for when you want a fresh one.

games.name: NameTen
games.blurb: A daily hidden sports top ten. Correct guesses go into their ranked slots.

games.name: Top Answer Club
games.blurb: Type the six most popular survey answers before you lose 3 lives.
games.why: Same name-the-list feeling as Daily Tens.

games.name: Centumth
games.blurb: Today's Top 100 list: guess the items closest to #100.
games.why: A top-list game crossed with Krillion's go-obscure scoring.

games.name: Crowdle
games.blurb: Match the crowd's top four answers to the daily prompt, ranked.
games.why: A ranked list you fill from the crowd's answers.

games.name: Seldom
games.blurb: Give five valid answers that are as rare as possible.

games.name: Rarish
games.blurb: One safe answer and one deep cut, in 60 seconds.

games.name: Majority
games.blurb: Five prompts. Guess what most players will say.
games.why: The flip side of Krillion: go common, not rare.

games.name: Immaculate Grid: Football
games.blurb: Fill 9 squares with players who match both the row and the column.
games.why: Sports-knowledge recall, like the draft games.

games.name: HUNDO
games.blurb: Wager cards from ace to ten on ten trivia questions.
games.why: Ten questions with a strategy layer on top.

games.name: GeoDle Connections
games.blurb: Sort 16 countries into 4 hidden geographic groups.

games.name: Country Connections
games.blurb: 16 countries shown as flags, outlines, capitals or names. Find the 4 groups.

games.name: Fermi
games.blurb: Three estimation questions. Score by how close your guess is.
games.why: A good-guess game for a break from recall games.
